target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Manages public housing and Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher (HCV) Program for Ashtabula County. Mission is to provide clean and safe affordable housing with strong resident and community stakeholder relationships. Already partners with AffordableHousing.com for listings. Offers USDA Housing and Capital Fund programs. Needs landlord onboarding tools, tenant screening integration, and compliance tracking for voucher program participation.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Responsible for all residential housing within city limits. Housing Inspector conducts yearly inspections of rental units, exterior inspections of owner-occupied homes, and code enforcement. Requires landlord registration, yearly Occupancy Permit fees, and inspections to International Property Maintenance Code (IPMC) standards. Currently manual process via email - perfect for digital landlord portal with registration and inspection scheduling.
